description: Accessibility pass on the PUBLIC respondent form (apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.tsx, its QuestionField) and the editor mirror (apps/web/src/pages/FormPreviewPage.tsx, its PreviewQuestion), plus SignaturePad.tsx and focus-ring CSS in App.css. No behavior change: audit and complete the aria/label/keyboard/landmark work across ALL 15 question types (not just email), make choice groups proper grouped controls with accessible names, ensure keyboard operability and visible focus in both light and dark, label dynamic rows and the signature pad, fix heading/landmark/progress semantics, image alts, and non-color-only signals. Add renderToStaticMarkup component tests. Depends on FEAT-001: the --qivo-focus-ring variable and dark surfaces must already exist so focus styles are contrast-safe in both schemes, and the variable-driven classes from FEAT-001 are the ones this feature annotates. Must not alter inline validation, piping, theming, payment, skip logic, or any question type's behavior.
steps: Link every control to its label across all question types in QuestionField (PublicFormPage.tsx) and PreviewQuestion (FormPreviewPage.tsx). LONG_TEXT: give the <textarea> the inputId and <label htmlFor={inputId}> (public already has htmlFor; preview's bare <label> needs an id + htmlFor). FILE_UPLOAD and SIGNATURE: associate the visible label with the control (htmlFor to the file input id, or aria-labelledby). Add aria-required="true" to every control whose question.required is true (and to the generic input/textarea branch). Keep piping (resolvePipedLabel) intact.

Add a non-color-only required indicator: keep the red '*' but mark the glyph aria-hidden and add visually-hidden '(required)' text (or an explicit 'Required' pill) so the signal is not conveyed by color alone. Apply in both pages and the email field block in PublicFormPage.tsx.

Make choice groups proper grouped controls. Add id={`${inputId}-legend`} to the <legend> (preview: `${previewId}-legend`). Give SINGLE_CHOICE/YES_NO/RATING/LINEAR_SCALE role="radiogroup" and MULTIPLE_CHOICE role="group", each named via aria-labelledby pointing at the legend id. Keep the native <input type=radio/checkbox> controls (they provide aria-checked, arrow-key, Space/Enter for free) — do NOT convert to divs. For RATING/LINEAR_SCALE replace the current aria-label={resolvedLabel} with aria-labelledby to the legend for a single source of truth. Mirror in FormPreviewPage.tsx (which currently has neither role nor name on these).

Complete the inline-error wiring for ALL question types, matching the email field pattern already in PublicFormPage.tsx: on the errored control set aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby to the error element id, and render the error as

. Audit each branch (text/number/date/url/phone/email already wired; MULTI_ENTRY wires entry 0; ensure choice/rating/file/signature branches expose an error region when an error exists). Mirror in PreviewQuestion.

Focus and keyboard. In App.css add a visible :focus-visible ring (using the --qivo-focus-ring variable from FEAT-001, contrast-safe in light AND dark) to buttons (.submit-button/.secondary-button), .choice-item/.rating-item, the .color-scheme-toggle, and links, WITHOUT removing the existing input outline/box-shadow. Confirm (and leave intact) that focusFirstInvalid runs on failed Next/submit in PublicFormPage and that FormPreviewPage.validateCurrentSection focuses the first invalid.

MULTI_ENTRY dynamic rows (PublicFormPage.tsx; mirror in preview for parity). Give the '+ Add another' button aria-label="Add another entry" (remove buttons already have aria-label=`Remove entry N`). On add, move focus to the newly added input; on remove, move focus to a sensible neighbor (previous entry or the add button). Use refs/ids; do not change the entry data model or MAX_MULTI_ENTRY_COUNT behavior.

FILE_UPLOAD dropzone (role=button div): keep tabIndex=0 and Enter activation, ADD Space-key activation (onKeyDown handles ' '/'Spacebar') and an aria-label referencing the question label. Keep uploaded-image descriptive.

SignaturePad.tsx: associate the 'Sign above' instruction with the canvas via aria-describedby (canvas already has aria-label); ensure the Clear button is labeled (it has visible text — add aria-label only if the visible text is insufficient). Keep the opaque-white canvas backgroundColor.

Headings, landmarks, progress, images. Keep the form

as the title and avoid skipped heading levels for the 'Section N of M' counter (keep it a

; add aria-live="polite" so section changes are announced). The multi-section progress bar in PublicFormPage already has role="progressbar"+aria-valuemin/max/now — add the same to FormPreviewPage's progress bar which currently lacks it. Cover image keeps alt="" (decorative). Mark decorative success-screen emoji/icons aria-hidden with text alternatives present. Ensure selected choice state and error state carry a non-color cue (selected: a checkmark or border-weight change in addition to color; error: the existing error text).

Add a11y component tests with renderToStaticMarkup (node env, like src/components/Chips.test.tsx). If QuestionField is not already exported from PublicFormPage.tsx, add a NAMED export for it without changing the default page export. Create apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.a11y.test.tsx asserting: a text question links <label htmlFor> to the input id; an errored field renders aria-invalid="true" + aria-describedby pointing at the role="alert" error id; SINGLE_CHOICE renders role="radiogroup" with aria-labelledby to the legend id and MULTIPLE_CHOICE renders role="group"; MULTI_ENTRY renders add button aria-label="Add another entry" and a remove aria-label="Remove entry 2"; a required control exposes aria-required="true" and a non-color required text. Add a file-header comment stating honestly that these automated checks do NOT equal full WCAG conformance (manual screen-reader/AT testing still required).
acceptance_criteria: `cd apps/web && pnpm test` passes including the new PublicFormPage.a11y.test.tsx, and all prior suites remain green.
`cd apps/web && pnpm build` compiles with no type errors; `cd apps/web && pnpm lint` is clean.
Every input/textarea/select/choice control is associated with its question label; required controls expose aria-required="true" plus a non-color required indicator.
SINGLE_CHOICE/MULTIPLE_CHOICE/YES_NO/RATING/LINEAR_SCALE render as grouped controls (role=radiogroup/group) with an accessible name via aria-labelledby, keyboard-operable via native inputs.

Inline validation errors across all types use role="alert"/aria-live with aria-invalid and aria-describedby wiring; focus moves to the first invalid field on failed Next/submit (unchanged behavior, verified).

MULTI_ENTRY add/remove buttons have aria-labels and focus moves sensibly on add/remove; FILE_UPLOAD dropzone is keyboard-operable with Enter and Space and has an aria-label; the signature pad has an accessible instruction and a labeled Clear button.

Heading hierarchy is sensible, the <main> landmark is present, the progress indicator is announced (both pages) and not color-only, images have appropriate alts, and selected/error/required states are not color-only.
No change to inline validation logic, piping, theming, payment, skip logic, or any question type's behavior.
findings: IMPLEMENTED. Accessibility pass on the public respondent form, the editor preview mirror, SignaturePad, and focus-ring CSS. No behavior change to validation, piping, theming, payment, skip logic, or any question type.
